notes: 32 legal German counter placements (8 doctrine families x 4 variants), 8 Soviet fixed-start response schedules. Two independent seeds: deployment seed chooses bounded arrangement variants and combat seed controls original PRNG. All policies experimental, no Soviet initial redeployment.

soviet.focus: Rail-supported redeployment, fallback, and layered defense
